host.title: Charger host or IP
host.description: Hostname or IP address of the OpenEVSE WiFi module (local API, no cloud account).

username.title: Web UI username
username.description: Only if you enabled authentication in the charger's web UI.

chargeNowCurrent.title: Charge-now current (A)
chargeNowCurrent.description: Current used when you turn the outlet On. Leave blank to use the charger's configured maximum.

faultSensor.title: Show fault sensor
faultSensor.description: A contact sensor that opens on GFCI, no-ground, stuck-relay, over-temperature and other EVSE errors — useful for notifications.

websocket.title: Live updates over WebSocket
websocket.description: Use the charger's /ws push stream for near-instant updates; polling continues as a fallback.

matter.title: Show in the Apple Home Energy view (via Matter)
matter.description: Also publish the charger over Matter as a standalone electrical sensor. Requires Homebridge 2.3.0+ with Matter enabled on this plugin's child bridge; skipped safely otherwise.

oneOf.title: Throttled — push significant changes, plus every 5 minutes (recommended)
Poll only — never push; lowest traffic, breaks automations triggered by these values
